subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased and made editable, or adopt/replace it with a maintainer-owned target-repo fix?
rationale: The bug and implementation boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate is a conflicting fork PR with maintainer edits disabled.

options.title: Adopt or replace in target repo
options.body: Open a narrow target-repo fix or adopt the contributor patch with credit, then close or supersede the fork PR only after a viable replacement exists.

options.title: Ask for contributor rebase
options.body: Keep the issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase onto current main and enable maintainer edits if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open, accepting that the source-reproducible UI/TUI rendering bug remains unresolved meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace in target repo
recommendation.body: Open a narrow target-repo fix or adopt the contributor patch with credit, then close or supersede the fork PR only after a viable replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the merged shared sanitizer boundary and TUI leading-strip follow-ups, so they are the best available owner for the adoption-versus-replacement choice.
